messages:
maya: Heads-up — PR #8427 is blocked by architecture review. I linked the RFC but we need an explicit ARCH note about the SLO delta before merge.
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8427
RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/341-routing-fallbacks

rahul: Thanks, maya. I can take a look. Can you summarize expected p50/p95 token latency delta and the error-budget impact? Also paste the short diff or canary plan here.

maya: Quick summary: p50 +3–5ms, p95 +15–25ms under our tail workloads; estimated error-budget increase ~0.2% for the first 24h during canary.
Canary plan: 1% -> 10% -> 50% over 24h with automated rollback on >0.5% error jump or latency >+40ms p95.
Short config diff:```yaml
- cache_key_ttl: 60
+ cache_key_ttl: 30
- route_weights: {beta: 0.02}
+ route_weights: {beta: 0.10}
```

katie: Please add an "ARCH signoff" section in the RFC with that table (p50/p95/error-budget) and explicitly call out the rollback thresholds. I'll hold merge until arch LGTMs + release slot confirmed. :eyes:

rahul: Quick nit: make the TTL change configurable via env var (e.g., INFERENCE_CACHE_TTL) and add a short note on fallback ordering when the cache miss path is hit. If you add those two items I'll give the arch-ack.

maya: Will push updates in a minute — thanks. Also can someone with release perms check Friday morning for a release window? @katie

deploy-bot: Release calendar conflict detected: 2024-11-15 09:00 PT already reserved by infra-maintenance. Suggested alternatives: 2024-11-16 09:00 PT or 2024-11-15 14:00 PT.

katie: 11/16 09:00 PT works for me. I'll reserve that slot once we have arch ack.

rahul: LGTM pending the TTL env var + RFC section. Ping me after you push and I'll add the arch-ack comment.

maya: Pushed both changes and updated the RFC (added ARCH signoff table + rollback thresholds): https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/341-routing-fallbacks#arch-signoff
Thanks all — will follow up once rahul drops the ack and katie confirms the release slot. :thumbsup:
